description: Reading Your Love (RYL) reads the relationship between two people as two gauges: temperature — your drive for romance — and humidity — the depth of feeling for the other person. Give both birth dates and birth cities (birth times sharpen it) and RYL shows an interactive card with where each of you sits on each gauge, named in RYL's own words (Lukewarm / Moderate / Hot, Dry / Moist / Damp). The card is a preview: the exact reading, with the full story behind it, is one tap away on readingyourlove.com, with your details already filled in.

defaultPrompt: Does he actually like me? I was born March 14, 1995 in Seoul, he was born July 22, 1993 in Tokyo.
Is there a chance we get back together? I was born March 14, 1995 in Seoul, she was born July 22, 1993 in Tokyo.
Are we a good match? I was born March 14, 1995 in Seoul, they were born July 22, 1993 in Tokyo.
